root_cause: Conflict transition used a hard-coded 1.0 second threshold
fix: Introduced a 1.5 second conflict-grace constant and boundary-aware transition

root_cause: Unavailable edges reopened immediately after clear debounce
fix: Track first unavailable time and require the documented 5 second hold-off before OPEN

root_cause: Operator confirm contract had no severity-floor field and Respond defaulted missing R to MEDIUM
fix: Added validated severity_floor to API/request/result and apply it as a minimum severity without a default

root_cause: REJECT constructed PhysicalCommandSequence with obsolete fields and omitted required fields
fix: Construct a valid current-schema release sequence while preserving OFF/CLOSE/OFF cancellation specs

root_cause: CANCEL used the same invalid sequence construction as REJECT
fix: Use the same valid current-schema release sequence for CANCEL

root_cause: Event-level duplicate checks did not provide a transactional confirmation winner
fix: Added an insert-only database claim with a unique incident key; loser is logged as ignored
validation_evidence: concurrent two-session winner test; automatic-wins late-confirm test

root_cause: LOW behavior did not match the master implementation contract
fix: LOW now holds E1 at station, preserves NORMAL_CYCLE, requests amber indication for 5 seconds, and issues no gate or emergency-buzzer action

root_cause: MEDIUM behavior did not match the master implementation contract and corridor target was implicit
fix: MEDIUM now dispatches E1, targets the selected PRIMARY/STANDBY corridor, pulses the buzzer at 500 ms, keeps the gate closed/default, and requests amber indication

root_cause: Retry publishing omitted command_id so the service generated a second identity
fix: Retry republishes the same logical command_id and records retry_of_command_id
validation_evidence: test_fv039_retry_reuses_command_id; controlled E2E retry identity reused
